paper_000: HADDOCK original (2003): AIRs from CSP/mutagenesis, rigid-body EM, TAD-SA, water refinement. Success on EIN-HPr, EIIA-HPr, gp120-CD4 (iRMSD <2A).
paper_001: HADDOCK2.0 (2007): Multi-body, ab initio modes, desolvation term, CAPRI performance improvement (65-71% success).
paper_002: HADDOCK2.2 webserver (2015): User-friendly, mixed molecules, new restraints (RDC, PCS), grid computing.
paper_003: Protein-glycan HADDOCK (2024): Benchmark on 89 bound complexes, 70% top5 success with ti-aa AIRs, unbound protocol with glycan sampling.
